title: Report index page: group reports by their primary object (derived, no key) and offer 最近 / 我创建的 / 全部 views
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

Ruled: 6509006168 · letter B · 2026-10-29T21:43Z — 「我创建的」 view and the owner column are out of this card (maintainer 「B」 in the decision thread); PR #27622 closes it.

## Source (main `273137d227`)

The app report index (`AppReportIndexView`, route `<app>/reports`, objectui#13020) lists every report the member may open as one flat list. The report schema carries no grouping key (no `category` / `folder`), and the index has no personal views. Mainstream systems all group (Salesforce folders + 最近 / 我创建的 / 全部; Dynamics categories; Zoho folders by module).

## Target (maintainer, 2026-10-29, verbatim: 「ui（索引页按对象分组 + 最近/我的/全部）」)

1. Group the index by each report's primary object, derived from its dataset / object (no new key): one section per object in the app's navigation order, a 「其它」 section for reports with no object; section headers show the count and collapse.
2. Three views across the top: 最近（the member's recently opened reports, read from the existing recent-items store）/ 我创建的 / 全部; the choice is a per-user preference through the `workspacePreference` store (#27052), scope `user`.
   > Ruled B (6509006168): 我创建的 is out of this card; the views are 最近 / 全部. Ownership returns with the North Star reports line (`saved-report-ownership`).
3. A row shows the report's label, object, owner and last-opened time; the search box filters within the current view.
   > Ruled B (6509006168): the owner cell is out of this card; a row shows label, object and last-opened time.
4. No `category` / `folder` key: that is a later card if an app pulls it (cross-object folders).

## File surface

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppReportIndexView.tsx` and its tests, i18n in all ten packs, changeset; ⛔ `packages/spec/**`.

## Acceptance

- Pins: grouping by object with the 「其它」 fallback; the two views (最近 / 全部, per ruling 6509006168) and their persistence; the search filter within a view.
- Screenshot of HotCRM's index (ten reports across lead / opportunity / case) on a never-merged evidence branch.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` on 2026-10-29 on the maintainer's instruction; independent of the spec card for the index navigation item (the index page exists today), so it lands in either order.</sub>
